special.text: Bybit blocks US residents, US IPs and US ID documents; no US entity and no US launch planned. A California resident cannot get this card.
Caps kill the rate: Apex 6% stops at 250 USDT/mo, Infinite 10% at 600 USDT/mo. $50k/mo at 10% nets 1.2%, not 10%.
Spend tier = current-month spend, applied the day after settlement, kept through the END of the following month (VIP tier is instant while VIP holds).
VIP by assets OR 30-day volume: VIP1 $100k/$1M spot, VIP3 $500k/$10M, VIP4 $1M/$25M, VIP5 $2M/$50M, Supreme $100M spot only.
EEA card: EUR 5,000 per purchase AND per day, so one ~$3,800 bar a day max; $50k/mo needs 13+ separate days.
0.9% crypto-to-fiat conversion (min EUR 1) when crypto settles a purchase; 0.5% FX on non-EUR; EU Base tier cut to 1% Aug 2026.
Bybit may withhold points on any transaction it deems abusive even if the MCC is not on the excluded list; Mastercard, so Costco US would refuse it anyway.
MCC 5300 Wholesale Clubs is on CoinZoom's capped list: rewards only on the first $5,000 per rolling 30 days. Black 5% = max $250/mo at Costco.
Per-swipe max by tier: Green $500, Silver $1,000, Gold $2,000, Diamond $4,000, Black $10,000. A $3,800 bar needs Diamond or Black.
Black: $10,000/day and $30,000/week POS. $50k/mo is physically possible (2 bars a day) but only $5k of it earns.
Tier = ZOOM held at time of each swipe, no lock period; Black = 300,000 ZOOM ~ $2,250 at $0.0075 (Sep 15 2026). ZOOM is thin and volatile.
Rewards are paid in ZOOM token, not USD; tiny market (~$0.007) so cashing $250/mo of ZOOM may cost several % in spread and price drift.
Fund the USD wallet by ACH ($100k/day, free) and spend USD; if the card sells crypto to pay, a 1.49% liquidation fee applies.
US Visa debit, all states except New York; CA ok. Capped-category list and rates can change at CoinZoom's sole discretion.
Exclusions are by MCC: precious metals/stones/jewelry, stamp+coin stores, money orders, financial institutions, tax, govt. Costco is MCC 5300, not on the list.
Terms ban 'Manufactured Spending' (anything X reasonably deems meant to generate cashback artificially); X may deny, claw back from your balance, or restrict the account.
No published cap, but terms say total cashback 'may be capped' and X picks the percentage at its sole discretion. $50k/mo of gold is a visible target.
X Card purchases $25,000/day default (can request higher); no per-swipe max published. $50k/mo is 2 days of buying.
Needs an active X Premium subscription: $84/yr on the web ($96 via app store); Premium+ adds nothing to the 3%.
Live to all Premium/Premium+ US users since Sep 2, 2026; not in NY or MA; CA fine. Deposits at Cross River Bank; Visa debit, PIN works at Costco.
Cashback auto-redeems weekly and refunds claw it back; no Costco gold data point found yet - test one bar before scaling.

Default $12,000/day and $150,000/YEAR spend cap per issuer, so $50k/mo cannot run for a full year.
Activation 0.1 USDC in first 72h else 10 USDC; physical card $49; inactivity $1/mo; 1.7% FX on non-USD; USDC-to-USD spread ~0.5-1.5% (unverified estimate).
Rewards paid in your chosen asset (BTC, gold, tokenized stocks, USDC) T+7; excluded MCCs and caps set in-app and changeable by Bitget.
Network is Visa or Mastercard depending on the regional issuer; Mastercard variants would be refused at Costco US.
